scope: RewindBox Xbox 360 playlist (PR #172, docs/xenios-playlist.md): pubspec.yaml adds the local workspace plugin xenia_internal_bridge (packages/xenia_internal_bridge; its podspec declares BSD-3-Clause) to the workspace and dependencies. The dedicated JIT helper pod packages/xenia_jit_helper (podspec declares GPL-3.0) is derived from RewindBox's ARMSX2 helper by tools/xenia/derive_jit_helper.py. No hosted package is added or removed; pubspec.lock is unchanged. The XeniOS engine (XeniaCore.framework, built from xenios-jp/XeniOS by build-utils/xenia, BSD-3-Clause) and Apple's Metal Shader Converter (libmetalirconverter.dylib, Apple terms) are not built from this tree, not committed and not bundled: their corresponding-source and notice declarations are due when the Core ships (main session).
